text:
Amy_CS: FYI MaplePay flagged — 40% drop in embeddings + feature usage over the last 30d. Finance just pinged for renewal review; procurement opened an RFP and mentioned CloudBrains as a competitor. Need fast triage.

Raj_Solutions: Do we have a product breakdown? embeddings vs chat vs rerank?

Amy_CS: embeddings is the bulk of the drop. Quick numbers: weekly avg tokens per active user down from ~120k -> ~72k. Top workspace down 60%. There was a small error spike last week but that was mitigated. snippet:
```
last_30d embeddings calls: 18.4k (-44%)
chat calls: 5.2k (-8%)
avg latency p95: 210ms -> 230ms
```

Kevin_PM: Any stakeholder change on their side? Last champion was Jordan (CTO).

Amy_CS: Jordan left two weeks ago. New interim lead is Sara (VP Product). Procurement explicitly asked for SLA + perf benchmarks and cost per 100k tokens vs CloudBrains pilot. Customer quote from their procurement email: "We need clear unit economics and tail latency comparisons."

Raj_Solutions: Can we run a quick benchmark and produce a cost-delta slide? Also recommend a 1-hr enablement session for the new product lead to regain trust.

Amy_CS: I'll draft the benchmark. Eng help needed for a perf run — tagging eng: @Maya_Eng.

Maya_Eng: I can run perf by tomorrow lunchtime. Need model spec, sequence length distribution, and a small sample prompt set.

ProcureBot: [automated] Renewal date for MaplePay: 2026-05-17. Last contract value: $120k/yr.

Sara_Customer: Thanks for the heads-up. We're running two pilots; speed and reliability are the main factors. Happy to do a deep dive next Tue afternoon.

Kevin_PM: Action items:
- Amy_CS: deliver benchmark + cost comparison by EOD Fri
- Raj_Solutions: prepare enablement deck + 1h playbook for new product lead
- Maya_Eng: perf run and anonymized P95/P99 logs
- CS: schedule call with Sara for Tue (capture agenda)
Please update owners in-thread :thumbsup:

Amy_CS: On it — creating the calendar invite and will post the draft benchmark here when ready.

Raj_Solutions: I'll focus the deck on tail latency, batching gains, and practical quantization options to reduce cost. Do we have legal OK to share anonymized P95 numbers?

Amy_CS: Legal gave the green light for anonymized and aggregated metrics. Tagging Kevin_PM for visibility.

Kevin_PM: Noted. Also include a short appendix on quantized model variants and expected unit cost savings.

Maya_Eng: Running the perf will require a small maintenance window; I can use a canary pool. Will post results and logs here.

Amy_CS: Thanks everyone — will sync next update after perf results.
